$comment: Independent adjudication (plan orch-4281815e task n7, naming-analyzer, read-only) of legacy names that tests use as fixtures AND that occur as whole words in production files without a proven/exempt ledger row. UI_TEXT = user-visible text or natural-language AI/heuristic text (stays Portuguese); COMMENT_OR_DOC = comment only; FRAGMENT = hyphen-split piece of a compound legacy slug already covered by full-slug rows; TECH and MISSING_ROW are open defects until the entry is resolved (class changed to RESOLVED with a reason). Entries may carry a `reason` (added when the pair was adjudicated by reading the code); BOUNDARY entries are real legacy boundaries that cannot get a census-visible ledger row until the census gap named in their reason is closed.

entries.name: notas
entries.reason: Only occurrence is inside the doc comment of HIDDEN_INTERNAL_HINT that names the retired Portuguese columns (notas_internas / observacoes_internas / comentarios_internos); the regex itself matches English names only and a reintroduced Portuguese column is guarded by report-entity-definition.service.spec.ts. No operational use remained after the rename to internal_notes.

entries.name: imposto
entries.reason: Real legacy boundary: the read-only preflight in migrate-application.ts lists the pre-CZ-041 persisted transactions.type values (receita, despesa, investimento, imposto, transferencia) next to the canonical English ones to warn about rows outside both vocabularies (chk_transactions_type is NOT VALID). A ledger row cannot be added today: the census does not scan names inside SQL template strings, so a row for this pair is reported as OBSOLETE_BOUNDARY and fails the census. Open until the census covers SQL string values (gap reported) or the legacy list is dropped with the type backfill.

entries.name: Comunicação
entries.reason: Real legacy boundary: key of the legacy marketing_sector slug map (pre-AP3 persisted sector label 'Comunicação' -> 'communication'); the sibling keys (Design, Audiovisual, Marketing) are English-like and the other map keys already have rows. A ledger row cannot be added today: the census data-position rule (isDataPosition) only reports capitalized literals that are values of sector/department/queue/segment/stage/phase properties or compared against them, never object-literal keys, so the row would be OBSOLETE_BOUNDARY. The behavior is exercised by marketing.service.legacy-wiring.test.ts (own row). Open until the census covers capitalized map keys (gap reported).
